title: What It Really Costs to Own a Bugatti Veyron
description:
A new Bugatti Veyron cost about one point seven million dollars. A set of its tyres has been quoted at anything from twenty-five to forty-five thousand dollars. An oil change has been quoted at three thousand, twenty-one thousand, and thirty thousand dollars, by different people. And in twenty twenty-six one sold at auction for more than five million. This is what it really costs to own a Bugatti Veyron, and what the sources disagree about. We read Wikipedia, CNBC, Motor One, Motorious, Fox News, and the auction reports. The costs vary a lot between sources, so we show every figure with who said it. Where we do the arithmetic, it is labelled as ours. And where there is no published number, such as insurance, we say that plainly, because for the Veyron the missing numbers matter as much as the printed ones.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
